# Constraints for CI's pip installs (`pip install -c .github/ci-constraints.txt`).
# pyproject.toml keeps its ranges; these pins make CI test what the campaign runs.
#
# transformers: the campaign venvs run 5.16.1, and the GLM source derivative
# (prismaquant/glm_source_derivative.py) binds the modeling_glm5_next.py that
# 5.16.1 ships. transformers 5.17.0 ships another file, so tests of the
# derivative cannot run on it (#1419).
transformers==5.16.1
#
# pytest: CI installed the newest pytest, which moved from 9.1.1 to 9.2.0 on
# 2026-10-28. In 9.2.0, MonkeyPatch.setattr on an instance takes the value to
# restore from the instance __dict__ unless the class defines a data
# descriptor. torch.backends.cuda.matmul serves
# allow_bf16_reduced_precision_reduction through __getattr__ and __setattr__,
# so undo() calls delattr() and raises AttributeError, and 22 stage A tests
# that patch that flag fail. Every hosted run behind
# .github/hosted-known-failures.txt used 9.1.1 (#3140).
pytest==9.1.1
